tasks.analysis: Fungi, a group of organisms that include mushrooms and yeast, are not plants but a separate branch of life. They can be found in almost every environment and play essential roles in various ecosystems. Many of them are decomposers, meaning that they break down organic matter and recycle nutrients back into the soil. Some fungi form symbiotic relationships with plants, helping them absorb water and nutrients.
